subject: Supplier change: request to confirm EU exportability and evidence
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@edgepath.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier change + ask: Signalfold onboarding and EU export check

Hi Tessa,

We were notified by our procurement team that Signalfold (our telemetry partner) will be added as a supplier on EdgePath's ingestion pipeline next week. Before we proceed, Legal has asked for Redwood's current supplier list for any processors that touch our EU-region telemetry, plus any exportability/evidence that processing remains within EU or the paths that would lead to cross-border transfers.

Quick asks:
- Can you share your current list of third-party processors that may touch telemetry or logs (if any) for EU tenants?
- For any that are US-hosted, can you provide evidence of contractual safeguards and whether onshore fallbacks are available?
- If Signalfold is going to be added as a downstream processor, will there be any change to routing/egress?

We need this by EOD Monday (11/9) to keep our rollout timeline.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Ops, EdgePath Analytics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@edgepath.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier change + ask: Signalfold onboarding and EU export check

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the deadline. Attaching our current subprocessor snapshot (redwood_subprocessors_v3.csv). Summary below:

- Short list for EU telemetry/logs: EdgeRelay (EU region), LogHaven (multi-region, primary in EU), MetricsStore (EU but has US backup).
- Known US-hosted processors that could see derived telemetry for analytics: StreamLens (US), Signalfold (not currently in our roster).

We do have contractual safeguards (DPA plus SCCs) for cross-border transfers; where customers require onshore-only processing we offer a routed path that pins data to EU-hosted processors (onshore fallback). Jonas — can you confirm exportability evidence and whether Signalfold onboarding would change any egress pathways?

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_v3.csv (CSV)

If you want, Marissa can produce an evidence snapshot (SCC/DPA extracts + network egress map) for your legal review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@edgepath.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier change + ask: Signalfold onboarding and EU export check

Tessa / Oliver — looping in legal detail. Per the inventory:

- The CSV attached by Tessa is correct for processors that handle telemetry. For EU tenants the default serving and primary telemetry storage remain within EU regions (EdgeRelay + LogHaven).
- MetricsStore has a US backup that mirrors aggregated metrics; however, that backup does not contain raw customer prompts or PII — only aggregated counters and derived telemetry. We treat that as low-risk, but I note it for completeness.
- Signalfold (if added) would be classified as a downstream analytics processor. Our standard onboarding for that class currently results in US-hosted processing unless the customer requests an EU-only routing.

Recommended reply text for Redwood (for your legal):
"Signalfold will be a downstream analytics processor that may receive derived telemetry. For EU customers, Redwood will by default route telemetry to EU-hosted processors; customers may request an onshore-only routing which we can configure to prevent cross-border transfers. All transfers are governed by our DPA and Data Transfer Addendum (SCCs where applicable). Evidence package attached: network egress map and DPA extract."

Follow-ups / actions:
- If EdgePath requires Signalfold to be EU-hosted, we can discuss an onshore-only SLA but this will require additional provisioning (estimate 3-4 weeks).
- Marissa: please create the evidence snapshot (SCC pages + network egress diagram + short statement of data classes) and share a signed addendum template if needed.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@edgepath.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier change + ask: Signalfold onboarding and EU export check

Oliver — attaching the evidence snapshot you requested (edgepath_evidence_snapshot.pdf). Quick summary:

- Processors that touch EU telemetry are listed in the attached CSV.
- Default processing is EU-hosted; derived/aggregated telemetry may replicate to a US backup for MetricsStore only (no raw content).
- If you need Signalfold to be EU-hosted, we can support that as an onshore-only routing addendum. Estimated provisioning and validation: 3 weeks, additional fees may apply.

Proposed next step: if EdgePath is OK with the default routing + contractual safeguards (DPA + SCCs), sign the short DPA addendum linked here: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/12345-Redwood-DPA-addendum and we'll proceed with the supplier onboarding. If you require onshore routing for Signalfold, please let us know and we'll provide a firm quote and timeline.

Attachments: edgepath_evidence_snapshot.pdf (PDF)

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
